description: Paste a marketing or influencer-marketing statistic (a sentence or a whole paragraph), or ask for a reference number (e.g. 'what share of US adults use TikTok'). Returns the best-matching checked claim with its verdict, confidence, primary source, what the source actually says, a safe rephrasing and the claim URL, plus its kind (stat_check or reference_fact), as_of date, last_checked date and stale flag (last checked more than 180 days ago), and close alternatives. Returns match: none when the stat is not in the database.

text.description: The statistic as you saw it, e.g. 'influencer marketing returns $5.78 per $1'

name: check_stat
title: Check a marketing stat
